segments.title: Snap Camera Outage
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns from a break to find Windows has broken Snap Camera, leaving Chet invisible and the studio short-staffed; Hype Train briefly appears before the feed is left mostly empty.

segments.title: The Downloaded Baby
segments.notes: Case Blackwell talks with a baby-like downloaded program about child labor, Kickstarter funding, No Breaks November, and Grand Theft Auto 6.

segments.title: Crum's Gum Meta
segments.notes: Crum appears as the only available co-host, chews gum, discusses his wife, stem cells, gambling, old songs, and claims he entered Case's home to check on Windows.

segments.title: Jensen Huang Resignation
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and the baby program cover reports that Jensen Huang resigned amid an affair with Alice Huang, with analysis of Nvidia stock and the AI build-out.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Make-Up Schedule
segments.notes: Case Blackwell plugs the Patreon, promises daily make-up broadcasts through Sunday, and closes with a raid.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell anchored through a Snap Camera outage, covered Jensen Huang, and promised make-up No Breaks November streams.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Debate analyst Crum appeared as the only available co-host, chewed gum, discussed his wife and gambling, and claimed he entered Case's home to update Windows.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Hype Train briefly commandeered the feed with a frustrated freestyle before abandoning the broadcast.

characters.name: Baby
characters.notes: A downloaded baby program served as Case's temporary co-host, demanding Kickstarter money and helping cover the Jensen Huang resignation.

storylines.beat: [16:11] Case Blackwell admits the No Breaks November streak was broken and schedules make-up streams through Sunday.

lore_notes.fact: Crum claims he used a self-made key to enter Case's home and check on Case's outdated Windows installation.
Crum is cited as the third-best mayor of New Rennerton.
The baby co-host is identified as a website or browser extension Case downloaded roughly a year and a half earlier.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returned from a break with Snap Camera offline, leaving the newsroom understaffed and forcing Case Blackwell to anchor with Crum and a downloaded baby program. The broadcast covered Jensen Huang's resignation and affair allegations while treating the technical outage as a live control-room emergency. Blackwell closed by plugging the Patreon, promising make-up No Breaks November streams through Sunday, and signing off with a raid.
